functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_taxonomy_reconcile_reviewed_outbox_service(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_enabled boolean;v_count integer;
BEGIN
 IF p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'OUTBOX_RECOVERY_LIMIT_INVALID' USING errcode='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT enabled INTO v_enabled FROM private.work_taxonomy_review_outbox_control_v1
 WHERE singleton;
 IF v_enabled IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
 WITH accepted AS (
   SELECT s.account_id,s.client_request_id,s.review_id,
      'WORKER_CAPABILITY'::text AS purpose,
      w.envelope->'classificationCandidates' AS plans,s.created_at
   FROM private.worker_ai_saves s
   JOIN private.worker_ai_reviews w ON w.id=s.review_id AND w.account_id=s.account_id
   WHERE w.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
     AND w.envelope->>'classificationCatalogFingerprint' IS NOT NULL
     AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(w.envelope->'classificationCandidates')='array'
       THEN jsonb_array_length(w.envelope->'classificationCandidates') BETWEEN 1 AND 24
       ELSE false END
   UNION ALL
   SELECT c.account_id,c.client_request_id,c.review_id,
      'NEED_SERVICE'::text AS purpose,
      t.envelope->'classificationCandidates' AS plans,c.created_at
   FROM private.ai_task_review_commands c
   JOIN private.ai_task_reviews t ON t.id=c.review_id AND t.account_id=c.account_id
   WHERE c.state IN ('ACCEPTED','EVALUATING','EVALUATED','PUBLISHED')
     AND t.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
     AND t.envelope->>'classificationCatalogFingerprint' IS NOT NULL
     AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.envelope->'classificationCandidates')='array'
       THEN jsonb_array_length(t.envelope->'classificationCandidates')=1
       ELSE false END
 ),
 missing AS (
   SELECT a.* FROM accepted a
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_review_outbox_v1 q
     WHERE q.owner_account_id=a.account_id AND q.request_key=a.client_request_id)
   ORDER BY a.created_at,a.review_id LIMIT p_limit
 ),
 inserted AS (
   INSERT INTO private.work_taxonomy_review_outbox_v1
     (owner_account_id,request_key,source_review_id,purpose,plans)
   SELECT account_id,client_request_id,review_id,purpose,plans FROM missing
   ON CONFLICT(owner_account_id,request_key) DO NOTHING
   RETURNING id
 )
 SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_count FROM inserted;
 RETURN v_count;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_taxonomy_bind_reviewed_worker_service(p_owner_account_id uuid, p_request_key uuid, p_source_review_id uuid, p_profile_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 v_existing private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1%ROWTYPE;
 v_batch private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1%ROWTYPE;
 v_review private.worker_ai_reviews%ROWTYPE;
 v_save private.worker_ai_saves%ROWTYPE;
 v_profile public.app_profiles%ROWTYPE;
 v_digest text;v_item jsonb;v_plan jsonb;v_category uuid;
 v_key text;v_mode text;v_seen text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];
 v_modes text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];v_onsite boolean:=false;v_remote boolean:=false;
 v_result jsonb;v_count integer:=0;v_skills jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'role','')<>'service_role' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_SERVICE_ROLE_REQUIRED' USING errcode='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_owner_account_id IS NULL OR p_request_key IS NULL
   OR p_source_review_id IS NULL OR p_profile_id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_INPUT_INVALID' USING errcode='22023';
 END IF;
 -- Replays are read-only and bound to the very same worker/review/request.
 SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1
  WHERE owner_account_id=p_owner_account_id AND request_key=p_request_key FOR UPDATE;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF v_existing.source_review_id<>p_source_review_id OR v_existing.profile_id<>p_profile_id
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_REQUEST_KEY_REUSED' USING errcode='22023'; END IF;
  RETURN v_existing.result;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_batch FROM private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1
  WHERE owner_account_id=p_owner_account_id AND request_key=p_request_key
   AND source_review_id=p_source_review_id AND purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
  FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_batch.result->>'status'<>'COMMITTED'
   OR v_batch.result->'requiresBinding' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR v_batch.result->'capabilityAuthority' IS DISTINCT FROM '"NONE"'::jsonb
   OR v_batch.result->'notificationAuthority' IS DISTINCT FROM '"NONE"'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(v_batch.plans)<>'array'
   OR jsonb_typeof(v_batch.result->'items')<>'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(v_batch.plans) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 24
   OR jsonb_array_length(v_batch.result->'items')<>jsonb_array_length(v_batch.plans)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_ADMISSION_NOT_COMMITTED' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_review FROM private.worker_ai_reviews
  WHERE id=p_source_review_id AND account_id=p_owner_account_id FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_review.envelope->>'classificationState'<>'READY'
   OR v_review.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM v_batch.review_digest
   OR v_review.envelope->'classificationCandidates' IS DISTINCT FROM v_batch.plans
   OR v_review.envelope->'canAccept' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(v_review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')<>'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(v_review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')
       <>jsonb_array_length(v_batch.plans)
   OR v_review.envelope->>'profileId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_profile_id::text
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_REVIEW_NOT_BOUND' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
 v_digest:=encode(extensions.digest(
  ((v_review.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')
    ||jsonb_build_object('baseHash',v_review.base_hash))::text,'sha256'),'hex');
 IF v_digest IS DISTINCT FROM v_batch.review_digest THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_REVIEW_DIGEST_INVALID' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_save FROM private.worker_ai_saves
  WHERE review_id=p_source_review_id AND account_id=p_owner_account_id
    AND client_request_id=p_request_key FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_save.created_at>v_review.expires_at
   OR v_save.receipt->'saved' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR v_save.receipt->>'profileId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_profile_id::text
   OR v_save.receipt->>'profileStatus'<>'ACTIVE'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_SAVE_OR_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
 -- A delayed outbox command from an OLD Save must never re-enable modes
 -- superseded by a newer user-confirmed worker review for this same profile.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_ai_saves newer
   WHERE newer.account_id=p_owner_account_id
     AND newer.created_at>v_save.created_at
     AND newer.receipt->>'profileId'=p_profile_id::text)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_NEWER_SAVE_EXISTS' USING errcode='PT409'; END IF;
 -- Hold current worker profile throughout the transaction. Reject any edit
 -- after the reviewed Save, even if the new skill text happens to be identical.
 SELECT * INTO v_profile FROM public.app_profiles
  WHERE id=p_profile_id AND account_id=p_owner_account_id AND kind='WORKER'
  FOR UPDATE;
 v_skills:=v_review.envelope#>'{profile,skills}';
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_profile.profile_status<>'ACTIVE'
   OR v_profile.updated_at>v_save.created_at
   OR jsonb_typeof(v_skills)<>'array'
   OR to_jsonb(v_profile.skills) IS DISTINCT FROM v_skills
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_CURRENT_PROFILE_REQUIRED' USING errcode='PT409'; END IF;
 -- Make every scope and category EXACT. A related branch never certifies ability.
 FOR v_count IN 0..jsonb_array_length(v_batch.plans)-1 LOOP
   v_plan:=v_batch.plans->v_count;
   v_item:=v_batch.result->'items'->v_count;
   v_key:=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service');
   v_mode:=v_item->>'mode';
   IF v_plan->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM v_mode
     OR private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_plan->>'service') IS DISTINCT FROM v_key
     OR v_plan->>'action' NOT IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE','CREATE_CHILD','CREATE_NEW_BRANCH')
     OR v_mode NOT IN ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
     OR jsonb_typeof(v_item->'categoryId')<>'string'
     OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_skills) offered(value)
       WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(offered.value#>>'{}')=v_key)
     OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
        v_review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') m(value)
       WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(m.value->>'service')=v_key
         AND m.value->>'mode'=v_mode)
     OR v_key||'|'||v_mode=ANY(v_seen)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_SERVICE_OR_MODE_NOT_REVIEWED' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
   v_seen:=array_append(v_seen,v_key||'|'||v_mode);
   v_category:=(v_item->>'categoryId')::uuid;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
      JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm ON cm.category_id=c.id
      WHERE c.id=v_category AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
        AND cm.execution_scope=v_mode
        AND (c.canonical_key=v_key OR EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
          WHERE a.category_id=c.id AND a.normalized_key=v_key)))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_CATEGORY_STALE' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
   -- A past withdrawal (excluded=true) is NOT permanent: the owner may
   -- deliberately offer this service again in a NEW signed Save. ONLY this
   -- binder may restore it, with zero inherited related-offer consent.
   IF v_mode='ON_SITE' THEN v_onsite:=true; ELSE v_remote:=true; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- A recent explicit global-mode change must not be overwritten by a delayed
 -- binder from an older review. All updates below are ONE DB transaction.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
   WHERE choice.worker_profile_id=p_profile_id AND choice.updated_at>v_save.created_at)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_BINDER_NEWER_GLOBAL_MODE' USING errcode='PT409'; END IF;
 IF v_onsite THEN v_modes:=array_append(v_modes,'ON_SITE'); END IF;
 IF v_remote THEN v_modes:=array_append(v_modes,'REMOTE'); END IF;
 INSERT INTO private.worker_execution_mode_choices(
   worker_profile_id,worker_account_id,modes,consent_source,confirmed_at,updated_at)
 VALUES(p_profile_id,p_owner_account_id,v_modes,'EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REVIEW',
   statement_timestamp(),statement_timestamp())
 ON CONFLICT(worker_profile_id) DO UPDATE
   SET modes=excluded.modes,consent_source='EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REVIEW',
       confirmed_at=statement_timestamp(),updated_at=statement_timestamp();
 -- Catalog identities and per-service scope are granted only AFTER the
 -- signed review, saved receipt and current profile all passed.
 FOR v_count IN 0..jsonb_array_length(v_batch.plans)-1 LOOP
   v_item:=v_batch.result->'items'->v_count;
   v_category:=(v_item->>'categoryId')::uuid;v_mode:=v_item->>'mode';
   INSERT INTO private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities(
      worker_account_id,category_id,confirmed_at,allow_related_offers,excluded,origin)
   VALUES(p_owner_account_id,v_category,statement_timestamp(),false,false,'WORKER_CONFIRMED')
   ON CONFLICT(worker_account_id,category_id) DO UPDATE
     SET confirmed_at=statement_timestamp(),updated_at=statement_timestamp(),
         excluded=false,allow_related_offers=false,origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED';
   INSERT INTO private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1(
     worker_account_id,category_id,execution_scope,source_review_id,source_request_key,
     confirmed_at,active,handoff)
   VALUES(p_owner_account_id,v_category,v_mode,p_source_review_id,p_request_key,
     statement_timestamp(),true,v_batch.plans->v_count->'handoff')
   ON CONFLICT(worker_account_id,category_id,execution_scope) DO UPDATE
    SET source_review_id=excluded.source_review_id,
        source_request_key=excluded.source_request_key,
        confirmed_at=statement_timestamp(),active=true,handoff=excluded.handoff;
 END LOOP;
 -- The CURRENT complete review replaces old per-service permission. Retain
 -- history, but deactivate obsolete modes; never manufacture a related opt-in.
 UPDATE private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 old
 SET active=false
 WHERE old.worker_account_id=p_owner_account_id AND old.active
   AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_batch.result->'items') item(value)
     WHERE (item.value->>'categoryId')::uuid=old.category_id
       AND item.value->>'mode'=old.execution_scope);
 v_result:=jsonb_build_object('status','BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES',
   'workerProfileId',p_profile_id,'serviceModeCount',jsonb_array_length(v_batch.plans),
   'catalogVersion',v_batch.catalog_version,'dispatchAuthority','NONE',
   'notificationAuthority','NONE','relatedOfferAuthority','NONE');
 INSERT INTO private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1(
   owner_account_id,request_key,source_review_id,profile_id,catalog_version,result)
 VALUES(p_owner_account_id,p_request_key,p_source_review_id,p_profile_id,
   v_batch.catalog_version,v_result);
 RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_redaction_scope_v5(r text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if not(r=any(private.closure_redaction_relations_v5())) then raise exception 'ERASURE_RELATION_NOT_ADMITTED';end if;
 return case
 when r='public.agreement_invalidations_v1' then
  't.agreement_id in(select id from public.agreements where requester_account_id=$1 or worker_account_id=$1)'
 when r='public.app_accounts' then 't.id=$1'
 when r in('public.app_profiles','public.ai_conversations','public.ai_messages','public.ai_structured_facts','public.ai_action_proposals',
  'private.requester_identity_commands','private.worker_ai_saves','private.ai_task_review_commands','private.ai_task_reviews','private.worker_ai_reviews',
  'private.worker_ai_sessions','private.ai_need_turn_commands','private.worker_ai_turns','private.need_draft_save_commands','private.qa_ai_commands',
  'private.data_export_artifacts','public.data_export_requests','private.owned_media_assets','private.agreement_photo_uploads_v5','private.agreement_voice_uploads_v1',
  'private.retention_jobs','private.retention_holds','private.support_commands_v5','private.support_grant_commands_v5',
  'private.group_message_visibility_v5','private.ai_test_accounts_v5','private.support_operator_grants_v5','private.support_read_markers_v5','private.account_lineage_v5','private.account_lineage_events_v5') then 't.account_id=$1'
 when r='private.agreement_review_comments_v1' then 't.author_account_id=$1' when r in('private.need_edit_commands','private.need_publish_commands','private.remaining_search_close_commands') then 't.requester_account_id=$1'
 when r in('private.response_submit_commands','private.response_withdraw_commands','private.response_revision_resolution_commands',
  'public.marketplace_responses','public.worker_match_preferences','private.worker_calendar_events','public.opportunity_deliveries') then 't.worker_account_id=$1'
 when r in('public.profile_availability_rules','public.profile_availability_windows') then 't.profile_id in(select id from public.app_profiles where account_id=$1)'
 when r='private.worker_calendar_serialization' then 't.worker_profile_id in(select id from public.app_profiles where account_id=$1)'
 when r in('public.need_sensitive','public.need_geography','public.need_requirement_details','private.need_revision_events','private.need_publication_decisions',
  'private.dispatch_schedule','public.dispatch_rounds') then 't.need_id in(select id from public.needs where requester_account_id=$1)'
 when r='public.needs' then 't.requester_account_id=$1'
 when r in('private.response_application_snapshots','public.marketplace_response_versions') then 't.response_id in(select id from public.marketplace_responses where worker_account_id=$1)'
 when r='private.preselection_qa_questions' then 't.asker_account_id=$1'
 when r='private.preselection_qa_answer_versions' then 't.answered_by_account_id=$1'
 when r='private.preselection_qa_policy_decisions' then
  '(t.question_id in(select id from private.preselection_qa_questions where asker_account_id=$1) or t.need_id in(select id from public.needs where requester_account_id=$1) or t.id in(select policy_decision_id from private.qa_ai_commands where account_id=$1))'
 when r='private.preselection_qa_materiality_decisions' then
  '(t.question_id in(select id from private.preselection_qa_questions where asker_account_id=$1) or t.need_id in(select id from public.needs where requester_account_id=$1) or t.id in(select materiality_decision_id from private.qa_ai_commands where account_id=$1))'
 when r in('private.preselection_qa_commands','private.account_block_commands','private.agreement_location_commands','private.agreement_location_points') then 't.actor_account_id=$1'
 when r in('public.agreement_messages','private.group_messages_v5') then 't.sender_account_id=$1'
 when r='public.agreement_change_proposals' then 't.agreement_id in(select id from public.agreements where $1 in(requester_account_id,worker_account_id))'
 when r='public.agreement_versions' then 't.agreement_id in(select id from public.agreements where $1 in(requester_account_id,worker_account_id))'
 when r='public.agreement_execution' then 't.problem_opened_by=$1'
 when r='public.access_grants' then '$1 in(t.granted_by_account_id,t.granted_to_account_id)'
 when r in('public.notification_preferences','public.notification_push_devices') then 't.user_id=$1'
 when r='public.notification_push_attempts' then 't.delivery_id in(select id from public.notification_deliveries where recipient_user_id=$1) or t.device_id in(select id from public.notification_push_devices where user_id=$1)'
 when r='public.notification_deliveries' then 't.recipient_user_id=$1'
 when r='public.user_activity_events' then 't.recipient_user_id=$1 or t.entity_id in(select id from public.needs where requester_account_id=$1)'
 when r='private.marketplace_audit_log' then 't.actor_user_id=$1 or t.entity_id in(select id from public.needs where requester_account_id=$1) or t.entity_id in(select id from public.marketplace_responses where worker_account_id=$1)'
 else null end;
end $function$

functions.name: rpc_taxonomy_capture_gemini_turn_hints_service
functions.signature: public.rpc_taxonomy_capture_gemini_turn_hints_service(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, text, bigint, jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_taxonomy_capture_gemini_turn_hints_service(p_account_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid, p_client_request_id uuid, p_turn_id uuid, p_attempt_id uuid, p_purpose text, p_catalog_version bigint, p_proposals jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 v_source text;v_digest text;v_existing private.work_taxonomy_gemini_turn_hints_v1%ROWTYPE;
 v_row jsonb;v_count integer;v_seen text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];v_normalized text;
BEGIN
 -- Definer privileges alone are not authorization; require the actual JWT role.
 IF coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'role','') <> 'service_role' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_DENIED' USING errcode='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_account_id IS NULL OR p_conversation_id IS NULL OR
    p_client_request_id IS NULL OR p_turn_id IS NULL OR p_attempt_id IS NULL OR
    p_purpose NOT IN ('WORKER_CAPABILITY','NEED_SERVICE') OR
    coalesce(p_catalog_version,0) < 1 OR
    jsonb_typeof(p_proposals) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR
    pg_column_size(p_proposals)>18000 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_INVALID' USING errcode='22023';
 END IF;
 v_count:=jsonb_array_length(p_proposals);
 IF (p_purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' AND v_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 24)
    OR (p_purpose='NEED_SERVICE' AND v_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 6) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_INVALID' USING errcode='22023';
 END IF;
 FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_proposals) LOOP
   IF jsonb_typeof(v_row)<>'object'
      OR NOT (v_row ?& array['service','mode','action','categoryId','parentId','proposedPath','reason','catalogVersion'])
      OR (v_row-array['service','mode','action','categoryId','parentId','proposedPath','reason','catalogVersion','handoff'])<>'{}'::jsonb
      OR (v_row?'handoff' AND (v_row->>'mode'<>'REMOTE'
          OR NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(v_row->'handoff')))
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'service') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'reason') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'mode') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'action') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'categoryId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'parentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'catalogVersion') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
      OR char_length(btrim(v_row->>'service')) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
      OR char_length(btrim(v_row->>'reason')) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 1000
      OR v_row->>'mode' NOT IN ('REMOTE','ON_SITE')
      OR v_row->>'action' NOT IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE','CREATE_CHILD','CREATE_NEW_BRANCH')
      OR (v_row->>'catalogVersion')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM p_catalog_version
      OR jsonb_typeof(v_row->'proposedPath')<>'array'
      OR (v_row->>'action' IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE') AND
          (v_row->>'categoryId' IS NULL OR v_row->>'categoryId'=''
           OR v_row->>'parentId'<>'' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row->'proposedPath')<>0))
      OR (v_row->>'action'='CREATE_CHILD' AND
          (v_row->>'categoryId'<>'' OR v_row->>'parentId' IS NULL
           OR v_row->>'parentId'='' OR jsonb_array_length(v_row->'proposedPath')<1))
      OR (v_row->>'action'='CREATE_NEW_BRANCH' AND
          (v_row->>'categoryId'<>'' OR v_row->>'parentId'<>''
           OR jsonb_array_length(v_row->'proposedPath')<1))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_PLAN_INVALID' USING errcode='22023'; END IF;
   -- Identity duplicates cannot be used to smuggle another mode/service.
   -- The canonical normalizer collapses Serbian Cyrillic/Latin variants.
   v_normalized:=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_row->>'service');
   IF p_purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' THEN v_normalized:=v_normalized||'|'||(v_row->>'mode'); END IF;
   IF v_normalized IS NULL OR char_length(v_normalized)<3 OR v_normalized=ANY(v_seen) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_DUPLICATE_OR_INVALID_SERVICE' USING errcode='22023';
   END IF;
   v_seen:=array_append(v_seen,v_normalized);
 END LOOP;

 -- Only a DURABLY COMPLETED turn with the exact owner/attempt identity
 -- can produce a hint. A claimed/failed/cancelled or forged turn cannot.
 IF p_purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' THEN
   -- Completion takes this same lock before revision + 1. Hold it until the
   -- hint is inserted so a later completion cannot lend its source hash to
   -- an older succeeded turn.
   PERFORM 1 FROM private.worker_ai_sessions
    WHERE account_id=p_account_id AND conversation_id=p_conversation_id FOR UPDATE;
   SELECT encode(extensions.digest(
     convert_to(s.candidate::text||'|'||s.revision::text||'|'||s.base_hash,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   INTO v_source
   FROM private.worker_ai_turns t
   JOIN private.worker_ai_sessions s
     ON s.account_id=t.account_id AND s.conversation_id=t.conversation_id
   WHERE t.account_id=p_account_id AND t.conversation_id=p_conversation_id
     AND t.client_request_id=p_client_request_id
     AND t.turn_id=p_turn_id AND t.attempt_id=p_attempt_id
     AND t.state='SUCCEEDED' AND t.cancelled_at IS NULL
     AND t.completion_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     AND t.source_revision+1=s.revision;
 ELSE
   -- Need completion serializes on the owned conversation. Its durable
   -- receipt names the assistant message produced by that exact completion.
   -- Refuse a late capture after another turn/message, or during a new turn.
   PERFORM 1 FROM public.ai_conversations
    WHERE id=p_conversation_id AND account_id=p_account_id FOR UPDATE;
   SELECT encode(extensions.digest(private.ai_task_review_source(c.id)::text,'sha256'),'hex')
   INTO v_source
   FROM private.ai_need_turn_commands t
   JOIN public.ai_conversations c ON c.id=t.conversation_id
   JOIN public.ai_messages message ON message.conversation_id=c.id
     AND message.account_id=p_account_id AND message.role='ASSISTANT'
     AND message.id::text=t.receipt->>'assistantMessageId'
   WHERE t.account_id=p_account_id AND t.conversation_id=p_conversation_id
     AND t.client_request_id=p_client_request_id
     AND t.turn_id=p_turn_id AND t.attempt_id=p_attempt_id
     AND t.state='SUCCEEDED' AND t.cancelled_at IS NULL AND c.account_id=p_account_id
     AND c.purpose='NEED_INTAKE'
     AND t.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
     AND t.receipt->>'schemaVersion'='NEED_FACT_V2'
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ai_messages newer
       WHERE newer.conversation_id=c.id AND newer.sequence_no>message.sequence_no)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.ai_need_turn_commands newer
       WHERE newer.conversation_id=c.id AND newer.account_id=p_account_id
         AND (newer.state='PROCESSING' OR
           (newer.state='SUCCEEDED' AND newer.updated_at>t.updated_at)));
 END IF;
 IF v_source IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_TURN_UNCONFIRMED' USING errcode='42501';
 END IF;
 -- A succeeded LLM turn is NOT proof that any named service is in the current
 -- worker profile. The candidate's saved skills must contain every proposed
 -- service now, including after a later correction/removal in the same turn.
 -- A partial set is permitted as an untrusted hint, but the eventual owner
 -- review will refuse READY unless it covers ALL current services.
 IF p_purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_proposals) proposal(value)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_ai_sessions s,
        LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(s.candidate->'skills') offered(skill)
      WHERE s.account_id=p_account_id AND s.conversation_id=p_conversation_id
        AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(offered.skill)=
            private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(proposal.value->>'service')
    )
 ) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_WORKER_SERVICE_NOT_OFFERED' USING errcode='22023';
 END IF;
 v_digest:=encode(extensions.digest(p_proposals::text,'sha256'),'hex');
 INSERT INTO private.work_taxonomy_gemini_turn_hints_v1(
   purpose,account_id,conversation_id,client_request_id,turn_id,attempt_id,
   source_fingerprint,catalog_version,proposals,payload_digest)
 VALUES(p_purpose,p_account_id,p_conversation_id,p_client_request_id,
   p_turn_id,p_attempt_id,v_source,p_catalog_version,p_proposals,v_digest)
 ON CONFLICT(purpose,account_id,turn_id) DO NOTHING;
 SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM private.work_taxonomy_gemini_turn_hints_v1
   WHERE purpose=p_purpose AND account_id=p_account_id AND turn_id=p_turn_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_existing.client_request_id<>p_client_request_id
   OR v_existing.attempt_id<>p_attempt_id
   OR v_existing.conversation_id<>p_conversation_id
   OR v_existing.source_fingerprint<>v_source
   OR v_existing.catalog_version<>p_catalog_version
   OR v_existing.payload_digest<>v_digest
   OR v_existing.proposals IS DISTINCT FROM p_proposals THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TAXONOMY_CAPTURE_REPLAY_CONFLICT' USING errcode='22023';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('action','HINT_CAPTURED','authority','NONE');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_reconcile_pending_reviews_v1(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_count integer;
BEGIN
 IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PENDING_LEDGER_LIMIT_INVALID' USING errcode='22023'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT enabled FROM private.work_taxonomy_pending_control_v1 WHERE singleton) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
 WITH saved AS (
   SELECT s.account_id,s.client_request_id,s.review_id,'WORKER_CAPABILITY'::text purpose,
     r.envelope,s.created_at
   FROM private.worker_ai_saves s JOIN private.worker_ai_reviews r
    ON r.id=s.review_id AND r.account_id=s.account_id
   UNION ALL
   SELECT c.account_id,c.client_request_id,c.review_id,'NEED_SERVICE'::text,
     r.envelope,c.created_at
   FROM private.ai_task_review_commands c JOIN private.ai_task_reviews r
    ON r.id=c.review_id AND r.account_id=c.account_id
   WHERE c.state IN('ACCEPTED','EVALUATING','EVALUATED','PUBLISHED')
 ),
 missing AS (
   SELECT * FROM saved s WHERE
    s.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
    AND s.envelope->>'classificationState' IN
     ('PENDING_CLASSIFICATION','SERVICE_MODE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED','REVIEW_REQUIRED',
      'CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE','STALE_CATALOG')
    AND coalesce(s.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest','') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_pending_reviews_v1 p
      WHERE p.owner_account_id=s.account_id AND p.request_key=s.client_request_id)
   ORDER BY created_at,review_id LIMIT p_limit
 ),
 ins AS (
   INSERT INTO private.work_taxonomy_pending_reviews_v1
    (owner_account_id,request_key,source_review_id,purpose,classification_state,saved_at)
   SELECT account_id,client_request_id,review_id,purpose,envelope->>'classificationState',created_at
   FROM missing ON CONFLICT(owner_account_id,request_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
 )
 SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_count FROM ins;
 RETURN v_count;
END $function$

functions.name: taxonomy_signed_binding_requeue_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_signed_binding_requeue_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_valid boolean:=false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT'
    OR NEW.result->>'dispatchAuthority'<>'NONE'
    OR NEW.result->>'notificationAuthority'<>'NONE' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='work_taxonomy_need_bindings_v1' THEN
    IF NEW.result->>'status'<>'BOUND_NEED_REVISION' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    -- Recheck CURRENT requester revision and category. The binder holds the
    -- same Need row lock and has just inserted the signed snapshot.
    SELECT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.needs n
      JOIN private.work_taxonomy_need_snapshots snap
        ON snap.need_id=n.id AND snap.need_revision=n.revision
       AND snap.category_id=n.category_id
      WHERE n.id=NEW.need_id AND n.requester_account_id=NEW.owner_account_id
        AND n.revision=NEW.need_revision AND n.category_id=NEW.category_id
        AND n.status IN ('PUBLISHED','SELECTION')
        AND n.remaining_search_closed_at IS NULL
        AND (n.response_deadline IS NULL OR n.response_deadline>statement_timestamp())
        AND snap.reviewed_by_requester AND snap.classification_state='CONFIRMED'
    ) INTO v_valid;
    IF v_valid THEN
      -- Requeue, not dispatch. The next scheduler tick still enforces every
      -- signed service/scope, capacity, area, time, budget and duplicate gate.
      PERFORM private.enqueue_dispatch(NEW.need_id,statement_timestamp());
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1' THEN
    IF NEW.result->>'status'<>'BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    SELECT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.app_profiles p
      JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
        ON m.worker_account_id=p.account_id
       AND m.source_review_id=NEW.source_review_id
       AND m.source_request_key=NEW.request_key
       AND m.active
      WHERE p.id=NEW.profile_id AND p.account_id=NEW.owner_account_id
        AND p.kind='WORKER' AND p.profile_status='ACTIVE'
    ) INTO v_valid;
    IF v_valid THEN
      -- Existing bounded/idempotent world-scoped requeue (max 200 Need rows).
      -- Nothing here grants an ability or emits a notification.
      PERFORM private.requeue_open_needs_for_worker_v5(NEW.owner_account_id);
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Queue failures must never undo a verified owner Save/UUID receipt.
  -- Only a sanitized SQLSTATE; no account IDs, addresses, skills or task text.
  RAISE LOG 'TAXONOMY_BOUND_REQUEUE_FAILED:%',SQLSTATE;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_set_worker_execution_modes(p_worker_profile_id uuid, p_modes text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_account uuid:=auth.uid(); v_profile public.app_profiles; v_modes text[];
BEGIN
 IF v_account IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_REQUIRED' USING errcode='28000'; END IF;
 IF p_worker_profile_id IS NULL OR p_modes IS NULL OR cardinality(p_modes) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2
   OR array_position(p_modes,NULL) IS NOT NULL
   OR NOT (p_modes <@ ARRAY['ON_SITE','REMOTE']::text[])
   OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM unnest(p_modes) AS x)<>cardinality(p_modes)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_EXECUTION_MODES_INVALID' USING errcode='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT p.* INTO v_profile FROM public.app_profiles p
 WHERE p.id=p_worker_profile_id
 FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_profile.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_account
   OR v_profile.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'WORKER'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_PROFILE_NOT_OWNED' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
 IF v_profile.profile_status NOT IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_PROFILE_NOT_EDITABLE' USING errcode='42501'; END IF;
 v_modes:=CASE WHEN 'ON_SITE'=ANY(p_modes) AND 'REMOTE'=ANY(p_modes)
  THEN ARRAY['ON_SITE','REMOTE']::text[]
  WHEN 'ON_SITE'=ANY(p_modes) THEN ARRAY['ON_SITE']::text[]
  ELSE ARRAY['REMOTE']::text[] END;
 INSERT INTO private.worker_execution_mode_choices(worker_profile_id,worker_account_id,modes)
 VALUES(p_worker_profile_id,v_account,v_modes)
 ON CONFLICT(worker_profile_id) DO UPDATE SET modes=excluded.modes,
   confirmed_at=statement_timestamp(),updated_at=statement_timestamp()
 WHERE private.worker_execution_mode_choices.worker_account_id=v_account
   AND private.worker_execution_mode_choices.modes IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.modes;
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_execution_mode_choices x
   WHERE x.worker_profile_id=p_worker_profile_id
   AND x.worker_account_id=v_account AND x.modes=v_modes) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_MODE_CHOICE_CONSISTENCY_FAILED' USING errcode='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('workerProfileId',p_worker_profile_id,
  'modes',to_jsonb(v_modes),'confirmed',true,
  'matchingAuthority','NONE','notificationAuthority','NONE',
  'note','PREFERENCE_ONLY_UNTIL_MATCHER_INTEGRATION');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_taxonomy_claim_reviewed_batches_service(p_limit integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_docs jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'OUTBOX_CLAIM_LIMIT_INVALID' USING errcode='22023'; END IF;
 WITH selected AS (
  SELECT id FROM private.work_taxonomy_review_outbox_v1
  WHERE (state IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND retry_after<=statement_timestamp())
     OR (state='CLAIMED' AND lease_until<statement_timestamp())
  ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT p_limit
 ),
 claimed AS (
  UPDATE private.work_taxonomy_review_outbox_v1 q
   SET state='CLAIMED',attempts=q.attempts+1,
       lease_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_until=statement_timestamp()+interval '2 minutes',
       updated_at=statement_timestamp()
   FROM selected s WHERE q.id=s.id
   RETURNING q.id,q.owner_account_id,q.request_key,q.source_review_id,
    q.purpose,q.plans,q.lease_token,q.attempts
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',id,'ownerAccountId',owner_account_id,'requestKey',request_key,
  'sourceReviewId',source_review_id,'purpose',purpose,'plans',plans,
  'leaseToken',lease_token,'attempts',attempts) ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_docs FROM claimed;
 RETURN v_docs;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.data_export_snapshot(p_account_id uuid, p_receipt_id uuid, p_binding jsonb, p_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 with configured as (select value as config from jsonb_array_elements(p_binding#>'{delivery,datasets}')),
 owned_rows as materialized (select 'account' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'email',t.email,'fullName',t.full_name,'city',t.city,'phone',t.phone,'activeMode',t.active_mode,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.app_accounts t where t.id=p_account_id
union all
select 'profiles' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'kind',t.kind,'displayName',t.display_name,'city',t.city,'headline',t.headline,'bio',t.bio,'status',t.profile_status,'skills',t.skills,'operatingCountryCode',t.operating_country_code) as value from public.app_profiles t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'availabilityWindows' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'startsAt',t.starts_at,'endsAt',t.ends_at,'state',t.availability_state,'label',t.label) as value from public.profile_availability_windows t join public.app_profiles p on p.id=t.profile_id where p.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'availabilityRules' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'weekdays',t.weekdays,'startTime',t.start_time,'endTime',t.end_time,'startsOn',t.starts_on,'endsOn',t.ends_on,'active',t.active,'label',t.label) as value from public.profile_availability_rules t join public.app_profiles p on p.id=t.profile_id where p.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'calendar' as key,jsonb_build_object('agreementId',t.agreement_id,'startsAt',t.starts_at,'endsAt',t.ends_at,'state',t.state) as value from private.worker_calendar_events t where t.worker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'needs' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'title',t.title,'description',t.description,'status',t.status,'revision',t.revision,'countryCode',t.task_country_code,'timezone',t.task_timezone,'executionMode',t.execution_location_mode,'startsAt',t.starts_at,'endsAt',t.ends_at,'requiredSlots',t.required_slots) as value from public.needs t where t.requester_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'needPrivate' as key,jsonb_build_object('needId',t.need_id,'exactAddress',t.exact_address,'accessNotes',t.access_notes,'latitude',t.exact_lat,'longitude',t.exact_lng,'resolvedPoints',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slot',v->'slot','latitudeE6',v->'latitudeE6','longitudeE6',v->'longitudeE6','address',v->'address','accessNotes',v->'accessNotes') order by v->>'slot') from jsonb_array_elements(t.resolved_location#>'{value,points}') v),'[]'::jsonb)) as value from public.need_sensitive t join public.needs n on n.id=t.need_id where n.requester_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'responses' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'kind',t.response_kind,'status',t.status,'needRevision',t.submitted_against_need_revision,'priceRsd',t.price_rsd,'coveredSlots',t.covered_slots,'scopeNote',t.scope_note,'message',t.bounded_message,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.marketplace_responses t where t.worker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownQuestions' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'question',t.question_text,'status',t.status,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.preselection_qa_questions t where t.asker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAnswers' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'questionId',t.question_id,'version',t.answer_version,'answer',t.answer_text,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.preselection_qa_answer_versions t where t.answered_by_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'agreements' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'status',t.status,'currentVersion',t.current_version,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.agreements t where t.requester_account_id=p_account_id or t.worker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAgreementMessages' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'body',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at,'agreementVersion',t.agreement_version,'assetIds',to_jsonb(t.photo_asset_ids),'voiceAssetId',t.voice_asset_id) as value from public.agreement_messages t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.sender_account_id=p_account_id and (a.requester_account_id=p_account_id or a.worker_account_id=p_account_id)
union all
select 'consent' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'termsVersion',t.terms_version_label,'termsSha256',t.terms_content_sha256,'privacyVersion',t.privacy_version_label,'privacySha256',t.privacy_content_sha256,'acceptedAt',t.accepted_at) as value from public.account_legal_acceptance_events t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'notifications' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'role',t.recipient_role,'channel',t.channel,'state',t.state,'title',t.title,'body',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at,'readAt',t.read_at) as value from public.notification_deliveries t where t.recipient_user_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'aiMessages' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'role',t.role,'content',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from public.ai_messages t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'mediaMetadata' as key,jsonb_build_object('name',t.name,'createdAt',t.created_at,'bytesIncluded',false) as value from storage.objects t where t.bucket_id='profile-media' and split_part(t.name,'/',1)=p_account_id::text
union all
select 'exportRequests' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'kind',t.request_kind,'status',t.status,'requestedAt',t.requested_at,'completedAt',t.completed_at) as value from public.data_export_requests t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAudit' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'eventType',t.event_type,'entityType',t.entity_type,'entityId',t.entity_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.marketplace_audit_log t where t.actor_user_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownAgreementReviews' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'rating',t.rating,'tags',t.tags,'createdAt',t.created_at,'comment',(select c.comment from private.agreement_review_comments_v1 c where c.review_id=t.id)) as value from private.agreement_reviews t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.reviewer_account_id=p_account_id and (a.requester_account_id=p_account_id or a.worker_account_id=p_account_id)
union all
select 'ownSafetyReports' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'category',t.category,'reason',t.reason,'narrative',t.narrative,'status',t.status,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.safety_reports t where t.reporter_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownBlocks' as key,jsonb_build_object('targetAccountId',t.blocked_account_id,'active',t.active,'revision',t.revision,'updatedAt',t.updated_at) as value from private.account_blocks t where t.blocker_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiDrafts' as key,jsonb_build_object('conversationId',t.conversation_id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'revision',t.revision,'safety',t.safety,'profile',private.data_export_worker_candidate_v5(t.candidate),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.worker_ai_sessions t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiReviews' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'revision',t.revision,'activate',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'activate','boolean'),'profile',private.data_export_worker_candidate_v5(t.envelope->'profile'),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.worker_ai_reviews t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskAiReviews' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'draftId',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'draftId','string'),'draftRevision',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'draftRevision','number'),'responseDeadline',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.envelope->'responseDeadline','string'),'publicFacts',private.data_export_task_facts_v5(t.envelope->'publicProjection'),'privateFacts',private.data_export_task_facts_v5(t.envelope->'ownerPrivateProjection'),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_task_reviews t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where t.account_id=p_account_id and c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskAiFacts' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'facts',private.data_export_task_facts_v5(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key',t.fact_key,'value',t.fact_value,'displayValue',t.display_value,'status',t.status)))) as value from public.ai_structured_facts t join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=t.conversation_id where c.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiTurns' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.turn_id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'state',t.state,'createdAt',t.created_at,'cancelledAt',t.cancelled_at) as value from private.worker_ai_turns t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'workerAiSaves' as key,jsonb_build_object('reviewId',t.review_id,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.worker_ai_saves t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskReviewCommands' as key,jsonb_build_object('reviewId',t.review_id,'needId',t.need_id,'needRevision',t.need_revision,'state',t.state,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_task_review_commands t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'taskAiTurns' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.turn_id,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'state',t.state,'cancelledAt',t.cancelled_at,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_need_turn_commands t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'qaClassifications' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'needId',t.need_id,'needRevision',t.need_revision,'questionId',t.question_id,'type',t.command_type,'state',t.state,'outcome',t.outcome,'materiality',t.materiality,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.qa_ai_commands t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'qaCommands' as key,jsonb_build_object('type',t.command_type,'questionId',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.result->'questionId','string'),'status',private.data_export_scalar_v5(t.result->'status','string'),'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.preselection_qa_commands t where t.actor_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownedMediaAssets' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'scope',t.scope,'conversationId',t.conversation_id,'profileId',t.profile_id,'state',t.state,'selected',t.selected,'width',t.width,'height',t.height,'byteSize',t.byte_size,'bytesIncluded',false,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.owned_media_assets t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'testAdmission' as key,jsonb_build_object('admittedAt',t.admitted_at,'retiredAt',t.retired_at) as value from private.ai_test_accounts_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'testAllocations' as key,jsonb_build_object('kind',t.kind,'allocatedMaximumMicrousd',t.max_cost_microusd,'measuredProviderCharge',coalesce(t.settlement_basis='MEASURED',false),'settledMicrousd',t.settled_microusd,'settlementBasis',t.settlement_basis,'settledAt',t.settled_at,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value from private.ai_test_reservations_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'closureRequests' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'state',t.state,'revision',t.revision,'requestedAt',t.requested_at,'preparedAt',t.prepared_at,'closedAt',t.closed_at) as value from private.account_closure_requests t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'closureExecution' as key,jsonb_build_object('requestId',t.request_id,'state',t.state,'requestedAt',t.requested_at,'closedAt',t.closed_at) as value from private.closure_executions_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'closureActions' as key,jsonb_build_object('kind',t.kind,'state',t.state,'dispatchedAt',t.dispatched_at,'verifiedAt',t.verified_at,'evidence',t.evidence) as value from private.closure_actions_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownGroupMessages' as key,jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'groupId',t.group_id,'body',t.body,'createdAt',t.created_at) as value
 from private.group_messages_v5 t where t.sender_account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownGroupMemberships' as key,jsonb_build_object('groupId',t.group_id,'agreementId',t.agreement_id,'joinedAt',t.joined_at,'endedAt',t.ended_at) as value
 from private.group_memberships_v5 t where t.account_id=p_account_id
union all
select 'ownLocationSnapshots' as key,jsonb_build_object('agreementId',c.agreement_id,'agreementVersion',c.agreement_version,
 'latitude',t.latitude,'longitude',t.longitude,'accuracyMeters',t.accuracy_meters,'capturedAt',t.captured_at,'sharedAt',t.shared_at) as value
 from private.agreement_location_points t join private.agreement_location_commands c using(actor_account_id,client_request_id)
 join public.agreements a on a.id=c.agreement_id where t.actor_account_id=p_account_id and a.worker_account_id=p_account_id and c.kind='SHARE' and c.state='COMMITTED'

 from private.agreement_location_commands t join public.agreements a on a.id=t.agreement_id where t.actor_account_id=p_account_id and p_account_id in(a.requester_account_id,a.worker_account_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_compatible_v1(need_handoff jsonb, worker_handoff jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Historical missing data stays unknown; it is never rewritten as shipment
 -- consent. Existing unqualified tasks keep their prior compatibility policy.
 IF need_handoff IS NULL THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(need_handoff) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF need_handoff->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN
   RETURN worker_handoff IS NULL OR (private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(worker_handoff)
     AND worker_handoff->'required'='false'::jsonb);
 END IF;
 IF worker_handoff IS NULL OR NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(worker_handoff)
    OR worker_handoff->'required'<>'true'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(need_handoff->'shippingCountries','[]'::jsonb)) n(country)
   JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(worker_handoff->'shippingCountries','[]'::jsonb)) w(country) USING(country))
   OR (need_handoff ? 'localExchange' AND worker_handoff ? 'localExchange'
     AND need_handoff#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}'=worker_handoff#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}'
     AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(need_handoff#>>'{localExchange,city}')=
         private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(worker_handoff#>>'{localExchange,city}'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_city text;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR octet_length(p_value::text)>2048
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_value->'required') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    OR p_value-array['required','shippingCountries','localExchange']<>'{}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN RETURN p_value='{"required":false}'::jsonb; END IF;
 IF NOT(p_value?'shippingCountries' OR p_value?'localExchange') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value?'shippingCountries' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'shippingCountries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   IF jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value)
       WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR x.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
     OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value))
         <>jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p_value?'localExchange' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'localExchange') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR NOT((p_value->'localExchange')?&array['countryCode','city'])
     OR (p_value->'localExchange')-array['countryCode','city']<>'{}'::jsonb
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,countryCode}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR p_value#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,city}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_city:=p_value#>>'{localExchange,city}';
   IF v_city IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(v_city,
      U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF')
      OR char_length(v_city) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
      OR v_city ~ ('['||chr(1)||'-'||chr(31)||chr(127)||'-'||chr(159)||'<>0-9]')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$
